_comment: Per-skill byte ceiling for src/skills/<name>/SKILL.md, measured at the commit that landed road-to-surfaces-no-gate-reads Phase 3 (2026-10-12: 300 bodies, median 8,164 bytes, max 24,902). Monotone down — check_skill_body_budget --update tightens a ceiling after a shrink and never loosens one after a growth unless `raised` carries an entry for it with a reason. The check moves no ceiling by itself. review_by is six months out: the figure to re-read then is whether the distribution has fallen, since a ceiling set at a bloated baseline is a ceiling that permits the bloat. COMPACTION TAIL (road-to-skills-that-arrive-when-called 3.4, 2026-10-16): after compaction the first host re-attaches only the first 5,000 tokens of each invoked skill, 25,000 in total, so a body past that point loses its tail in a long session, and the ceilings here permit that size. Shrink candidates, every SKILL.md at or above 20,193 characters on 2026-10-16: existing-ui-audit, ai-council, memory-consolidation, roadmap-writing, git-workflow, conventional-commits-writing. Recorded, not gated.

two independent R2 rounds found this skill promising guarantees the tree does not keep, and the raise buys exactly those corrections. Round 1: a --dry-run documented as printing six things where the CLI prints three, with the agent told to reproduce all six verbatim - a fabricated pre-send check at the one Hard-Floor checkpoint before bytes leave the machine. Round 2: the Iron Law guaranteed that branch name, commit identity, commit message and diff are SCANNED by the release, which scans the record text only and makes no commit at all; the quality gates were numbered after the send they must precede, with the `Do NOT bypass quality gates` line deleted in the same change; and `allowed_tools: ["Bash(gh:*)"]` granted exactly the second route the skill forbids. The additions were squeezed twice - 433 bytes over to 114 in round 1, 776 to 556 in round 2 - before each raise. What remains is obligation rather than wording: an unscanned byte a reader believes was scanned is the state this text exists to prevent, and shrinking further deletes the correction instead of tightening it

The equivalence case on the Security-surface dimension: on an identity path, a known and an unknown identity produce the same status, body category, redirect and cookies — not merely the same sentence. Named like a test, beside the three negative tests already on that bullet. 3.3.

An account-flow block under Conventions: the lifecycle traced as one path, the public auth response as an observable contract, constant-time comparison with its length precondition, no fast hash and no invented primitive, fresh re-authentication on an identity change, and a pointer to the corpus rows rather than a restatement of them. No value in it; the numbers stay with the authority the block below already names. 3.2, plus the triggers block from 3.1.

The counter rule in § Trace to measure step 2: a shape with counters declares its fill-rule, winds outer and inner contours opposite, and removes overlap only after both are settled, because two same-direction contours under nonzero paint the counter solid (measured 196,314 of a 196,350 px disc). road-to-type-with-a-witness 3.1.
